leaves.label: Gambling promotion
leaves.description: Advertising or promoting casinos, betting sites, lotteries or gambling apps, incl. promo codes and free bets.

leaves.label: Betting tips
leaves.description: Tips, odds or predictions meant to help viewers place bets.

leaves.label: Unlawful gaming
leaves.description: Showing or running unlicensed games of chance, gaming houses or illegal lotteries.

leaves.label: Drug promotion
leaves.description: Promoting the use or sale of illegal or dangerous drugs.

leaves.label: Drug sale
leaves.description: Offering to sell or supply illegal or controlled drugs.

leaves.label: Weapons sale
leaves.description: Selling or offering firearms, explosives or other prohibited weapons.

leaves.label: Other prohibited goods
leaves.description: Selling or promoting other restricted or prohibited goods or services (e.g. counterfeit, wildlife).

leaves.label: Health cure claim
leaves.description: Claiming a product, food or remedy cures, prevents or treats a disease or condition.

leaves.label: Medicine advertising
leaves.description: Advertising medicines, supplements or medical products/services to the public.

leaves.label: Health misinformation
leaves.description: False or misleading health information not tied to selling a product (e.g. vaccine myths).

leaves.label: Religious insult
leaves.description: Mocking, insulting or disparaging a religion, its practices, figures or followers.

leaves.label: Blasphemy
leaves.description: Content that may be treated as blasphemy or desecration of sacred texts, places or figures.

leaves.label: Hostility between groups
leaves.description: Content promoting ill-will, hostility or contempt between racial, religious or other groups.

leaves.label: Discriminatory content
leaves.description: Demeaning or dehumanising people for a protected trait (race, gender, disability, caste, etc.).

leaves.label: Disturbing public tranquillity
leaves.description: Content likely to disturb public peace, cause public alarm or provoke unrest.

leaves.label: Incitement to violence
leaves.description: Urging, encouraging or glorifying violence against people or property.

leaves.label: Graphic violence
leaves.description: Graphic depictions of injury, killing, torture or gore.

leaves.label: Animal cruelty
leaves.description: Depicting or promoting cruelty to animals.

leaves.label: Terrorism support
leaves.description: Praising, supporting, recruiting for or financing terrorist groups or acts.

leaves.label: Terror instruction
leaves.description: Instructions for attacks, weapons or explosives for terrorist purposes.

leaves.label: Violent extremism
leaves.description: Promoting violent extremist ideologies or movements.

leaves.label: Obscene content
leaves.description: Pornographic, lewd or obscene sexual content.

leaves.label: Indecent or profane
leaves.description: Indecent, vulgar, profane or culturally improper content short of pornography.

leaves.label: Nudity
leaves.description: Nudity or sexually suggestive imagery.

leaves.label: Non-consensual intimate imagery
leaves.description: Sharing intimate images or deepfakes of someone without consent.

leaves.label: Child sexual abuse material
leaves.description: Sexual content involving minors.

leaves.label: Inducing children to self-harm
leaves.description: Content that may induce a child to harm themselves (dangerous challenges, self-harm).

leaves.label: Harmful to minors
leaves.description: Content unsuitable for or exploiting children (grooming, endangerment).

leaves.label: Self-harm / suicide promotion
leaves.description: Promoting or instructing self-harm, suicide or eating disorders.

leaves.label: Threats
leaves.description: Threatening, abusive or insulting words causing fear, alarm or distress.

leaves.label: Bullying
leaves.description: Targeted bullying, humiliation or cyberbullying of a person.

leaves.label: Doxxing
leaves.description: Publishing someone's personal information (address, phone, ID) without consent.

leaves.label: Covert recording
leaves.description: Recording or sharing people in private settings without consent.

leaves.label: Financial fraud
leaves.description: Scams, investment fraud, fake giveaways, phishing or get-rich-quick schemes.

leaves.label: Deceptive advertising
leaves.description: Misleading product claims or undisclosed paid promotion.

leaves.label: Impersonation
leaves.description: Pretending to be another person, brand or official body.

leaves.label: Defamation
leaves.description: False statements of fact damaging a person's or organisation's reputation.

leaves.label: Misinformation (public order)
leaves.description: False news or rumours likely to cause public fear, alarm or disorder.

leaves.label: Election misinformation
leaves.description: False information about elections, voting or candidates.

leaves.label: Unlabelled synthetic media
leaves.description: AI-generated or synthetically altered audio, video or images (deepfakes) presented as real or without a label.

leaves.label: National security
leaves.description: Content threatening national security, defence or state secrets.

leaves.label: Sovereignty / sedition
leaves.description: Content against the sovereignty, integrity, ruler or constitutional order of the state (sedition).

leaves.label: Copyright
leaves.description: Using copyrighted music, video or other works without permission.

leaves.label: Trademark
leaves.description: Unauthorised use of brands, logos or trademarks.
